Overview.Name: Aruna
Overview.Goal: Stay fit, improve overall energy and confidence through simple, consistent meals.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 2 whole eggs pan fried + cooked vegetables
OR Omelette with onions and tomatoes
Meal_2_Lunch: Chicken curry + small bowl rice + cooked vegetables
OR Fish pan fried + rice + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meals simple and home-cooked to stay consistent.
Since stress is a trigger, avoid skipping meals to prevent cravings later.
Prefer pan fried, boiled, or lightly cooked foods instead of deep fried.
Increase daily steps gradually toward 7,000 for better fitness.
If craving spicy food, keep portions controlled and pair with protein.
Drink enough water through the day to support digestion and energy.
Focus on regular meal timings to maintain steady energy levels.
